description:
Hi, I’m Zakariae! I am forming a team to work on AURASPACE, a project dedicated to creating cutting-edge Health Monitoring Software for Astronauts on Space Missions. Our mission is to build digital health dashboards and telemetry tools that will help keep future astronauts safe, healthy, and mission-ready.

🌌 Who We’re Looking For We are a passionate, collaborative squad, and we need talented people to help bring AURASPACE to life.
summary:
StellarPulse is a mobile-first, private self-care companion designed to help astronauts recognize stress early, decompress in the moment, and build sustainable recovery habits during long-duration space missions. Built with React 19, TypeScript, and Tailwind CSS, the application transforms traditional behavioral telemetry into an approachable, warm wellness experience centered around three core actions: Notice, Regulate, and Recover.

Long-duration spaceflight exposes crews to extreme isolation, confinement, disrupted circadian rhythms, and communication delays with Earth. Existing health systems often act as cold diagnostic dashboards that flag problems without helping crew members regulate emotions privately. StellarPulse addresses this gap by offering one-tap emotional check-ins, local-only voice/text venting never transmitted to Mission Control, daily self-care challenges, and zero-medication countermeasures like guided breathing and Earth soundscapes—empowering crew autonomy and psychological resilience beyond Earth.
details:
What It Does & How It Works StellarPulse is an interactive wellness and decision-support prototype designed to help crew members manage behavioral stress during long-duration orbital or deep-space missions. Instead of grading astronauts with clinical metrics, it guides them through five calming core experiences:

  • Now (Home): Provides one-tap mood logging and live sliders for isolation, anxiety, stress, and tension, dynamically recommending a two-minute intervention when stress levels rise.
  • Exercises: Offers four zero-medication, spaceflight-specific decompression tools: Cosmic Box Breathing (a guided breathing orb), Zero-G Muscle Release (targeting jaw, neck, and shoulder tension), Earth Rain & Forest Escape (sensory audio soundscapes), and Cabin Sunset Wind-Down (adjustable warm-light sleep preparation).
  • Vent: A local-only emotional release space supporting 15-second voice or text venting that remains strictly private to the user's device, paired with grounding reflections.
  • Challenges: Low-pressure daily self-care missions (such as logging mood three Sols in a row) that reinforce recovery habits without competitive stress.
  • My State: An encouraging seven-Sol summary highlighting mood trends and stress direction over time to make personal patterns understandable and actionable.

Creativity & Key Design Considerations Our team focused on psychological safety, low cognitive load, and privacy-by-default. Because astronauts operate under high workloads and delayed communication with Earth, we engineered StellarPulse to work completely offline without requiring real-time ground contact. Visually, we broke away from sterile, dark medical dashboards by designing a warm pastel UI (#F4F9FD airy backgrounds, rounded cards, and reassuring human-first language) that feels safe enough to use on a difficult day.

Benefits & Intended Impact StellarPulse closes the gap between detecting stress and taking immediate, helpful action. By lowering the friction to self-regulation and guaranteeing privacy, it encourages honest emotional check-ins and consistent recovery routines. Beyond spaceflight, this model can directly support crew well-being in analog environments such as polar research stations, submarines, and remote emergency response teams.

Tools & Technologies Used

  • Frontend Framework & Language: React 19, TypeScript, Vite
  • Styling & UI: Tailwind CSS, Lucide Icons
  • Routing: TanStack Router
